item.title: Mediterranean Sailing: Find the Right Island for You
item.description: Which Is The Best Mediterranean Island For You? Find Out Here! Whether you’re a boating aficionado or new to the art of sailing, there’s no doubt about it – Mediterranean island holidays are among the best in the world. The only downside of sailing the Mediterranean is choosing your destination from our 17 amazing base locations! From relaxing beaches and mouth-watering cuisine to historic marvels and action-packed hiking, anything is possible in the Mediterranean. Ready to experience the region at its best? With a Mediterranean yacht charter, you can easily visit the world’s most sought-after destinations in Greece, Italy, Croatia, Spain, and France – all from the comfort of your liveaboard yacht. If you’re unsure which Mediterranean island holidays you should visit, keep reading to discover the right destination for you. Which Is The Best Mediterranean Island For You? Find Out Below! Split, Croatia: for the Wine Enthusiasts If you’re all about wine tasting, you can’t miss Croatia . And if you’re sailing Mediterranean seas, you can’t miss Split and the Istrian peninsula. Depart from Trogir to sail to Split, Croatia’s second-largest city and a vibrant cosmopolitan hub with an abundance of high-end culinary options. It’s also located on the shores of the Adriatic Sea, giving visitors easy access to some of the Mediterranean’s most beautiful shores. Be sure to save time for a day trip – or an entire stop – in Hvar. This magnificent island attracts global travelers with its white-washed towns, cobblestone streets, clear blue shores, and home-style restaurants with incredible wine. If the wine weren’t enough, everything in this coastal paradise is the definition of picture-perfect. With sweeping natural views this stunning, each glass of wine tastes even better than the last! Greek Islands: Where History Fans Thrive If you have a passion for history, there’s one country you can’t miss: Greece . With Athens, Corfu, and more than 200 idyllic islands, Greece has an endless supply of ancient historic sites to visit. Although Athens isn’t on the coast, it’s easy to visit before or after your Mediterranean yacht charter. This ancient capital is home to the Acropolis and the Parthenon, arguably the most famous sites in Western history. Both are nearly 2,500 years old! If you have time, the Temple of Hephaestus, Mount Lycabettus, the Panathenaic Stadium, and the Ancient Agora of Athens are also essential Athens stops. As for the islands, history buffs will also love Corfu , where the first university and theater in Greece were founded. Santorini and Mykonos also attract history lovers, so don’t forget to add them to your yacht hire Mediterranean itinerary! Sardinia: for Beach Lovers Of the many Mediterranean island vacations to choose from, Sardinia might just have the most impressive beaches . As the second-largest island in the Mediterranean (after Sicily), this Italian paradise has sprawling, sparkling shores you could spend a lifetime exploring. What makes this destination so special? Each of the white sand, crystal clear blue water beaches offers something different. Aruttas and Spiaggia di Piscinas are great for solitude, while Chia is more family-friendly. Spiaggia Rena Bianca offers unmatched swimming, while Cala Goloritzè is perfect for beachfront hiking and climbing. The list is endless! For a more urban experience, sail over to Cagliari, the island’s capital city. It’s the perfect place to alternate between museums, restaurants, and unforgettable beach days. Mljet & Krka National Park: Natural Beauty at Its Best Although Mediterranean island vacations are usually focused on the beach, nature lovers can also explore national parks by yacht. We especially recommend this strategy for Krka National Park and Mljet National Park, two of Croatia’s most stunning natural wonders. Easily reached when sailing from Šibenik , Mljet National Park stretches across the entire northwest region of Mljet Island, a natural wonderland in the Adriat…

item.title: Our top cabin charter ‘no sailing experience’ destinations
item.description: We’ll take you to some of the finest places on earth with our catamaran by the cabin charter vacations . You can leave the sailing, itinerary details and meal preparation to our professional crew. No sailing experience is needed with our cabin charters and you definitely won’t be lifting a finger on this vacation! Kick back on our modern yachts and sail with us to Caribbean , Bahamas , Pacific , Mediterranean , Asia and the Indian Ocean . Our cabin charter vacations are perfect for couples looking for an exciting getaway, friends wanting a trip to remember or solo travelers. It’s perfect for those who want to avoid mass crowds and cruise ships. Our by the cabin charter destinations will introduce you to exotic flavors, new cultural experiences and natural beauty to last a lifetime, just take a look… The Caribbean Spirit Sail on our Caribbean cabin charters and discover exclusive islands that offer a laid-back atmosphere, beach bars, history and culture. There’ll be plenty of chances to taste the local produce and your chef will prepare delicious recipes with fresh tropical fruit, vegetables and fish. Don’t forget to try the rum cocktails while on your cabin charter! Choose from: BVIs – read a customer review St. Martin Martinique Guadeloupe Bahamas Nature Trail The region is popular due to its many islands, cays and nearly 2,400 islets. Choose one of our 7-night cabin charters and meet the wildlife, from swimming pigs to iguanas. It will be a sailing holiday to remember. Sail: Exumas Abaco French Polynesia Welcome Explore Tahiti , the archipelago of Tuamotu and the Society Islands, with a cabin charter. If you want to sail for a few days, we offer shorter cabin charters from Raiatea. If you want to explore for longer, we also offer 10-night sailing vacation packages. Explore Bora Bora, Rangiora, Huahine and much more aboard our large, comfortable catamarans in the South Pacific. Mediterranean Coastlines Our Corsica cabin cruises explore the beauty of the coast, sailing around Cargèse, Porto, Girolata and the Scandola Nature Reserve in the north. We also head south for Bonifacio and the Lavezzi archipelago. Sail the Costa Smeralda on a 7-night adventure in Sardinia, where you can visit Tavolara Island, the sand bar and lagoon at La Cinta and shops at Porto Cervo, as well as Porco, Santo Stefano and Palau. See the famous Amalfi Coast, including Procida, Ischia, Capri, Sorrento and Positano, plus much more on a tour of Italy. Taste the delights of Italian cuisine and see the impressive, colorful towns built into the cliffs. Our new 7-night Cabin Charter in Croatia, Dalmatian Dream Premium, may be a good choice for beautiful clear waters, historical landmarks and Island hopping to some of areas 1,000 islands and islets. Plus, new for 2025, you can now join us in Athens for our brand new Cabin Charter, Athens Dream Premium. This 7-night experience will sail you to some of the most beautiful locations in the Peloponese and Saronia Gulf, including Perdika, Hydra, Spetses and Poros. Choose from: Corsica, France Sardinia, Italy Naples and the Amalfi Coast, Italy Trogir, Croatia Athens, Greece Indian Ocean Paradise Explore the numerous islands and reefs that are set in the vibrant Indian Ocean with a cabin charter. See the Seychelles’ Coco de Mer and meet its gentle tortoises. We offer cabin charters for up to 10 nights in the Indian Ocean where you can enjoy pristine marine parks, sandy beaches and imposing granite rocks polished by the relentless waves. Choose from: Seychelles Thailand’s Hongs Discover the famous Phang Nga Bay from Phuket, south of Thailand in the Andaman Sea, on a sailing vacation. This is one of the most beautiful sailing areas in the world with hundreds of idyllic islands surrounded by clear waters. The spectacular Phang Nga Bay, with its amazing limestone rocks, is a highlight that you can see with our Thailand cabin charter vacations .
